name: basile
display: Basile: Invertible Location Maps (Library of Babel / Babelia)
summary: Invertible location-to-content maps of the Library of Babel family (J. Basile): the recipe, a checked toy library, and the published Babelia engine run on its published constants.

provenance.origin: Written 2026-09-30 for FourthAgePapers/HyperindexingSystem, whose opening takes the algorithm behind libraryofbabel.info as its jump-off. Basile publishes the recipe and C++ for the image library, Babelia (github.com/librarianofbabel/libraryofbabel.info-algo, CC BY-SA-NC, uploaded 2019-01-02); the text library's own algorithm is not published. This engine implements the recipe generically, runs the published engine on its published constants read from a local copy (never vendored: ValaQuenta is GPL-3.0-only), and audits them. Basile's other public repositories were checked: LoB-API holds only a CC0 licence file (no code); LobThis (a fork of rik-degraaff/LobThis, licence not stated) is 5 small JavaScript files whose one request is reproduced as data; newsometimesatdawn and Dezmediah-site are web sites.

environment.arithmetic: exact arbitrary-precision integers (3.19-million-bit); float only for reported ratios and timings
external: librarianofbabel/libraryofbabel.info-algo files, fetched by fetch_published() into a local cache, CC BY-SA-NC, never vendored
